edges.reason: stake uses msg.sender to update _balances and to pull tokens.
unstake uses msg.sender to decrement _balances and send funds.
getReward reads and clears rewards for msg.sender.
exit operates on the caller's balance and rewards.
onlyRewardDistribution compares caller-controlled msg.sender with rewardDistribution.
onlyRewardDistribution gates execution of notifyRewardAmount.
onlyOwner compares caller-controlled msg.sender with _owner.
onlyOwner gates execution of setRewardDistribution.
onlyOwner gates execution of recoverExcessToken.
rewardDistribution state variable is read in the onlyRewardDistribution check.
_owner state variable is read in the onlyOwner check.
lastTimeRewardApplicable depends on miner-influenced block.timestamp.
notifyRewardAmount branches on block.timestamp and writes periodFinish/lastUpdateTime.
updateReward checkpoint uses block.timestamp via lastTimeRewardApplicable.
updateReward modifier wraps stake body.
updateReward modifier wraps unstake body.
updateReward modifier wraps getReward body.
updateReward(address(0)) modifier wraps notifyRewardAmount body.
updateReward computes rewardPerTokenStored via rewardPerToken().
updateReward writes user rewards using earned(account).
rewardPerToken calls lastTimeRewardApplicable.
earned reads the account balance through balanceOf.
earned uses rewardPerToken in its computation.
exit calls unstake.
exit calls getReward.
rewardPerToken divides by totalSupply().
totalSupply returns _totalSupply.
rewardPerToken adds accumulated rewardPerTokenStored.
rewardPerToken subtracts lastUpdateTime from the applicable time.
rewardPerToken multiplies by rewardRate.
lastTimeRewardApplicable takes min with periodFinish.
earned subtracts userRewardPerTokenPaid[account].
earned adds previously stored rewards[account].
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
stakeToken state variable is the target of the external safeTransferFrom call in stake.
stakeToken state variable is the target of the external safeTransfer call in unstake.
rewardToken state variable is the target of the external safeTransfer call in getReward.
External token call in stake transfers control to an untrusted token which may re-enter.
External token call in unstake transfers control to an untrusted token which may re-enter.
External token call in getReward transfers control to an untrusted token which may re-enter.
External call on a caller-supplied token address in recoverExcessToken.
amount parameter feeds stake accounting and event.
amount parameter is forwarded into safeTransferFrom.
amount parameter feeds unstake accounting and event.
amount parameter is forwarded into safeTransfer.
reward parameter drives notifyRewardAmount computation.
reward parameter is summed with leftover and divided in rewardRate computation.
_rewardDistribution parameter is written by setRewardDistribution.
_rewardDistribution parameter overwrites the privilege-holding rewardDistribution state variable.
token parameter selects the token to recover.
token parameter is used to construct the external transfer call.
amount parameter is used in recoverExcessToken.
amount parameter is forwarded into the recovery transfer.
remaining local is used in notifyRewardAmount branch.
remaining is multiplied by rewardRate to produce leftover.
leftover is added to reward in the rewardRate arithmetic.
reward local drives the getReward payout branch.
reward local is the value forwarded by safeTransfer in getReward.
account parameter selects the user in earned.
account parameter indexes _balances in balanceOf.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter amount is consumed only within stake, so it folds into the stake core function.
Parameter amount is consumed only within unstake, so it folds into the unstake core function.
Parameter reward is consumed only within notifyRewardAmount, so it folds into that core function.
Parameter _rewardDistribution is consumed only within setRewardDistribution, so it folds into that core function.
Parameter token is consumed only within recoverExcessToken, so it folds into that core function.
Parameter amount is consumed only within recoverExcessToken, so it folds into that core function.
Local variable remaining exists only inside notifyRewardAmount, so it folds into that core function.
Local variable leftover exists only inside notifyRewardAmount, so it folds into that core function.
Local variable reward exists only inside getReward, so it folds into that core function.
Parameter account is primarily consumed by the earned core computation, so it folds into earned.
